how: We read the website of every Washington DC wedding florist listed on Lazo (218 listings, 171 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day delivery shops, bouquet preservation services, a live wedding painter, a balloon and rental company, wholesalers, a u-pick farm shop and a venue. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What is in season locally for my month, and do you buy from the flower farms in Loudoun and Frederick County?
Does the quote cover delivery, setup and teardown, including a DC venue with a loading-dock window?
For an outdoor July ceremony, which blooms hold up in the humidity and which will wilt before the photos?

picks.name: Homestead Floral Wedding & Events
picks.blurb: Christina has been a floral designer for 40-plus years and runs Homestead Floral, a wedding and event florist in Hagerstown that offers a free consultation by call or text. Custom wedding and event design is the specialty.

picks.name: Frederick Flower Farm
picks.blurb: A flower farm in Frederick that designs custom wedding florals from seasonally fresh, hand-picked blooms and also opens U-pick fields in season. Frederick Flower Farm serves Frederick, Baltimore and the DC area.

picks.name: FlowerHouse
picks.blurb: Leah founded FlowerHouse after her own DIY wedding flowers in 2022 arrived a day late and molding, and the service is built so you do not DIY but do it with them: FlowerHouse designs and procures your palette and brings it to you. Tiers are published, up to a Luxe option with peonies and anemones.

picks.name: Sweet Blossoms
picks.blurb: A Frederick-area wedding florist that works foam-free, orders from domestic farms, is building relationships with local growers, composts all organic waste and recycles at least 75 percent of studio materials. Sweet Blossoms serves Maryland, DC and Northern Virginia, with designer's-choice flowers to shop online.

picks.name: Petal's Edge Floral Design
picks.blurb: Since 2004, Petal's Edge has done custom floral and event design for weddings across the DC area from its Alexandria base, designing to the client's style whatever the aesthetic. The site shows featured DC and Alexandria weddings.

picks.name: Nature of Design Events
picks.blurb: Janet Flowers started Nature of Design to bring other people's visions to life and, after 22 years in business, promises a process that is easy and enjoyable. A full-service event florist whose work runs from weddings to corporate galas, with every centerpiece designed as part of one composition.

picks.name: Sweet Root Village LLC
picks.blurb: Sweet Root Village began over a glass of wine and now runs an Alexandria studio with a team built around floral design and community. Event floral design with pre-designed collections as an option, and a stated interest in challenging norms around work-life balance and motherhood.

picks.name: Lucky Events Inc
picks.blurb: Lucky Events specializes in luxury Indian and South Asian wedding decor for couples across the DMV: custom mandaps, sangeet stages and floral design, with the venue transformed end to end. Based in Frederick.

picks.name: Twinbrook Weddings and Events
picks.blurb: A family-owned Northern Virginia florist since 1994 that does custom full-service wedding flowers and sends back a detailed quote, free, from its online wedding quote form. Past couples' albums are on the site, and the shop also runs free same-day delivery across NoVA and DC.

picks.name: The Fertile Burb
picks.blurb: Anna is a farmer-designer growing luxury wedding florals on a one-acre plot in Northern Virginia, designed to feel like a seasonal story: lush, textural and local. The Fertile Burb does weddings and elopements across Northern Virginia, DC and Maryland.

picks.name: Bee's Wing Farm
tags: a la carte or full service
picks.blurb: Chelsea Belle grows the flowers she designs with at Bee's Wing Farm in Bluemont, drawing on more than sixteen years of farming in Virginia, the Northeast and New Zealand. Wedding florals are wild, lush and textural, offered a la carte or full service, and the farm also sells wholesale to floral professionals.

picks.name: Dear My Event
picks.blurb: Dear My Event pairs certified wedding planning with floral design, so one Chantilly studio can handle both. For couples who know what they love, an a la carte floral option covers bouquets, boutonnieres and centerpieces without a full-service commitment.
